headline: Levi’s × Sacai just pushed denim proportions way past classic.
dek: The third Levi’s × Sacai collaboration lands today with 12 deconstructed denim pieces built around exaggerated volume, unexpected details and hybrid construction.
image_alt: Model wearing Levi’s x Sacai denim from the 2026 third collaboration

headline: Old Navy × Altuzarra turned fall basics into a full romance novel.
dek: Altuzarra’s 44-piece Old Navy collaboration mixes florals, Fair Isle, plaid tailoring and dramatic outerwear at accessible prices — with Alexa Chung fronting the campaign.
image_alt: Alexa Chung wearing Old Navy x Altuzarra from the 2026 collaboration campaign

headline: Dior’s Paris runway went sheer, metallic and sharply tailored.
dek: Jonathan Anderson’s latest Dior womenswear show paired metallic trousers and structured jackets with sheer feathered skirts, pleating and soft romantic details.
image_alt: Guest at Dior Spring Summer 2027 womenswear show during Paris Fashion Week

headline: L’Oréal Paris made its runway show a celebrity-scale beauty moment.
dek: Celine Dion closed L’Oréal Paris’s Paris Fashion Week show, alongside a lineup that included Kendall Jenner, Heidi Klum and Andie MacDowell.
image_alt: L'Oreal Paris Express Your Worth show during Paris Fashion Week
